description: On the green-covered bed in front of you there’s a pile of colorful beads, a purple-and-white beaded strand, and a black tape dispenser. The left hand steadies the end of the purple-and-white strand near the bottom center while the right hand moves in from the right to pick up a bead from the pile, brings it to the strand, pinches and guides it onto the string with both hands briefly coordinating, then the right hand releases and returns toward the bead pile as the left hand keeps holding the strand.
